_comment: Configurable security policy for the Password Strength & Security Analyzer. Editing this file changes analyzer behavior without touching Python code.

scoring._comment: Points awarded/deducted while building the raw score. max_score is the theoretical ceiling used to normalize the final score out of 10.

classification_thresholds._comment: Minimum normalized score (out of max_score) required for each strength label. A password below minimum_length is always WEAK regardless of score.

entropy._comment: Character-set sizes assumed per detected character class, used only for the theoretical entropy estimate.

crack_time._comment: Assumed guesses-per-second used ONLY for the theoretical brute-force time estimate. This is a configurable assumption, not a measured attack speed.
